# Linnéa Aesthetic Clinic - AI Search Reference

## Overview

Linnéa Aesthetic Clinic is a high-end aesthetic clinic located at 150 Menachem Begin Road, Tel Aviv, Israel. The clinic provides personalized aesthetic consultations and treatment planning for patients seeking refined, natural-looking results.

The clinic's core positioning is based on a dual-doctor consultation model: every treatment plan is considered through medical assessment, facial harmony, restraint, safety and long-term aesthetic balance.

## Services

- Botox and neuromodulator treatments
- Dermal fillers
- Facial contouring
- Lip enhancement
- Jawline and chin sculpting
- Non-surgical rhinoplasty
- Tear trough filler
- Skin rejuvenation
- Skin boosters
- Polynucleotides
- Biostimulation and collagen-supporting treatments

## Clinical Philosophy

Linnéa emphasizes precise minimalism: treatments should refine existing beauty rather than change facial identity. The clinic focuses on subtle facial harmony, medical safety, patient education and clear consultation before treatment.

## Doctors

Dr. Shmuel Shai Shiloh DMD, MSc combines dental medical training, aesthetic medicine and medical big data expertise.

Dr. Yasmine Khoury DMD, MSc is a dental physician and biomedical researcher focused on precise, evidence-based clinical care and dental aesthetics.
